summary: Use retail and e-commerce data to assess KPIs, baskets, funnels and returns. Explore the five-day course outline and apply for training.
lede: Retail data science uses sales, order and product records to support practical trading decisions. For retail analysts, e-commerce operations specialists and merchandising teams, the course covers CRISP-DM question framing, retail KPI validation, basket and repeat-order analysis, and checks of funnel performance and returns, using Excel to turn findings into operational recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with retail sales, e-commerce orders, product performance or trading reports and need to turn operational data into sound recommendations.
audience: Digital Commerce Managers using funnel data
modules: Retail KPI Logic and Data Grain
prerequisites: Working familiarity with retail or e-commerce operations, basic sales measures and spreadsheet tables is expected. No programming is required. Excel is used for hands-on calculations; advanced demand-forecasting concepts receive conceptual coverage, not implementation training.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
Data science & machine learning in practice
